description: Resolve coordinates to a human-readable place (city, state, county, timezone). Use when you have lat/lon but need a display name or the local timezone. Example: {"lat": 39.74, "lon": -104.99} -> Denver, Colorado, America/Denver.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to 90). Most tools also accept a `location` place-name string instead of lat/lon.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to 180). For continental US use negative values (west of the prime meridian).

name: reverse_geocode
title: Reverse geocode
